anomalies.observed: The zero-ohm resistors connect bus pins 19 and 21 together through R10 and R6, and pins 20 and 22 together through R22 and R19.
anomalies.expected: Only one of the alternative bus-pin mappings for each PWM channel should be selected. The specification says the GPIO-to-bus-pin mapping varies by M5Stack core variant and directs assembly to short the appropriate jumper pair.

evidence.quote: GPIO-to-bus-pin mapping differs by M5Stack core variant
Short R10, R10 for Core2 and CoreS3 / Short R9, R11 for others

anomalies.impact: The alternate GPIO pins are shorted together on the pass-through bus. If a connected M5Stack core drives those pins independently, the short can cause signal conflicts or GPIO contention; it also defeats the specified variant-dependent mapping.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows zero-ohm links populated across both alternatives for each PWM pin mapping, tying bus pins 19–21 and 20–22 together. This conflicts with the specification's instruction to select the appropriate mapping for the M5Stack core variant.
